_comment: Old WordPress page -> new-site disposition map for the content audit (the side-by-side review). Reconciled 2026-06-02 against the finalized triage in assets/feedback/page-triage-decisions.csv. Rule: a unit's 'sources' are the old pages whose content survives into that new page. keep + consolidate pages are always sources (the reviewer verifies the fold happened); a 'remove' page is a source ONLY if its content was genuinely absorbed/rewritten into the new page (e.g. old Mission + Mission/Vision/Values -> new Home; old public-preschool -> new LCDC). 'remove' pages with no surviving content are excluded, not reviewed. There is no 'Removed from the new site' bucket: retired pages are simply excluded. Every published WP page appears exactly once: in a unit's sources, or in 'excluded' with a reason.
